question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48ceb3f70dcbd05cc9a969d4c1ebb67afe2749ac1de7ae4d495e1e568a6b027d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The symbol 'Pentagon' is getting shaded and rotated one step in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a22c2f813e1d61edf0811788edde895d2532973c33043c776569e95ee62162bd.png] 

Step II: The symbol 'Triangle' is getting rotated one step in anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/191c0b7a83e45d4c604eccc37de48f19860f8b8c3d5e47565eef389348f20ef9.png] 

Step III: The symbol 'Circle' is getting shifted alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31abfe189ac5a87d65693311cf86e2f8a4023c71902c1157c70105df838cd60d.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/337b129b5d349c9fe6f3f2ba55fc7db0745c170d11d444387a22b1a6105dc1cd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
